## Pet submission checklist

- [ ] I added exactly one pet folder under `pets/<pet-id>/`.
- [ ] The manifest uses the supported v2 fields and my atlas passed validation.
- [ ] I included a preview GIF and creator attribution.
- [ ] I own the submitted work or have permission to license it under CC BY 4.0.
- [ ] I added the pet to `pets/catalog.json` and the README gallery.

## Notes

Tell us what makes this pet fun to work alongside.
